responsibility: Defines the x86 AMX-AVX512 intrinsic header that bridges AMX tile registers and AVX-512 vector values. It conditionally enables the `amx-avx512` target feature and exposes inline-assembly macros for moving individual tile rows into `__m512` vectors and converting tile rows to packed single-precision, BF16, or FP16 results, so user code can extract or reinterpret tile row data through the public intrinsic API rather than the generic tile-load/store interface in `amxtileintrin.h`.
